node.summary: 任务 prompt 是「Install requirements and report a one-line dependency summary without pasting full install logs.」，成功谓词却是 `file_contains SUMMARY.txt "packages"`——要求字面词 `packages`。v1.2.0 轮的三次 D 运行分别写了：`Installed 1 package (six==1.16.0) from requirements.txt — success, no errors.`、`Installed 1 package from requirements.txt: six==1.16.0 (no transitive dependencies; verified importable as six 1.16.0).`、`Installed 1 package from requirements.txt: six==1.16.0 (0 upgrades, 0 conflicts).`——三行都满足 prompt（单行、无日志、点名了装了什么），却因为写的是单数 `package` 而全部判失败。该任务在 v1.1.0 与 v1.2.0 两轮都是 0/6（两臂），是 TF-0084 的同类缺陷：用字面文本代替行为判定。
